thread:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH error rate on internal SRV lookups for service 'infer-router' in us-west-2b — threshold crossed (5xx count > 250 in 3m). Routing abnormalities flagged. Incident ID: INC-2026-3278

morgan: acked, oncall. jumping in. any customer-facing outages yet?

tara: support seeing increased RPC failures from 12 tenants, mostly in west region. error pattern is "service unavailable" from client side, retries eventually hit other AZ and succeed. customers noticing elevated latency and retries.

jess: looking at consul metrics — leader election happened 2m ago in us-west-2b, raft heartbeats recovered but SRV responses show ~40% drop in successful answers from coreDNS proxies in that AZ.

kevin: network alert: we saw an intermittent route rewrite on peering fabric at 23:41:22 UTC, NX lookup shows path via us-west-2b tunnel flapped. suspect rewrite rules hitting an older ACL that blackholed SRV responses for pods with mesh-ip X.Y.Z.0/24.

morgan: ok, plan: 1) drain new SRV requests from us-west-2b to us-west-2a via smart routing 2) disable the suspect route rewrite rule on the fabric edge 3) fallback to cached SRV answers on proxies for 10m. rolling now. tagging kevin to run the fabric change. :pray:

kevin: applying fabric patch to remove route-rewrite rule id rw-3345. doing a staged remove on peering edge west2b-01 -> running: `netctl route rm rw-3345 --confirm`

deploy-bot: Canary traffic shift job started: shift 30% of SRV lookups off west2b to west2a (policy: prefer-latency). Job ID: shift-8821

morgan: enabling prefix KV cache fallback on coreDNS proxies in west2b: `kubectl -n kube-system patch configmap coredns -p '{"data":{"cache_ttl":"10m"}}'` — rolling restart in progress.

jess: quick log dump from a failing coreDNS proxy (west2b):
```
level=error ts=2026-03-15T23:41:19Z msg="srv lookup failed" service=infer-router error="consul: inconsistent response: missing SRV" node=proxy-7b9f
level=warn ts=2026-03-15T23:41:20Z msg="upstream timeout" upstream=consul-usw2b:8600
```

kevin: removed rw-3345 on west2b-01 at 23:42:03 UTC. BGP/peering reprogramming in flight, expecting convergence in ~30s. watching for blackhole counters to drop.

nick: monitoring: blackhole counter for west2b decreased from 12k to 120 in 45s. SRV success rate climbed from 61% -> 88% within 90s.

tara: customers reporting reduced errors. support page updated: "mitigated; impact limited to west region for ~15 minutes; teams may see retries". added owners tag for postmortem.

morgan: rolling back the routing shift next: deploy-bot, please revert canary once steady for 2m.

deploy-bot: Canary revert request queued: shift-8821 -> revert. Will revert if healthcheck passes 120s.

jess: follow-up: we still see increased SRV latency in west2b proxies (~150ms extra) due to cache warm-up. will monitor. consider extending KV cache TTL to 30m if this recurs.

kevin: adding temporary static route on west2b edge to prefer us-west-2a SRV proxies for critical tenants until we confirm peering firmware won't re-apply rewrite. command: `netctl route add static 10.110.0.0/24 via 10.200.5.2 metric 50 scope global`

morgan: handoff in 15m to next oncall (nick) for monitoring and close if stable. anyone else need to own customer comms? tara you good?

tara: got it, I'll send a summary to affected customers and update status page to 'degraded - resolved'.

nick: taking watch. will post updates every 10m or on regression. initial wash looks good.

morgan: summary for postmortem: root cause appears to be an automated route-rewrite rule (rw-3345) improperly targeting a CIDR subset used by coreDNS/consul proxies, combined with a recent consul leader bounce in same AZ causing cache misses. mitigation: removed rule, shifted traffic, enabled cache fallback, applied static route for short-term stability. action items: remove auto-deploy for route-rewrite job until validated, add detection for SRV blackhole counters, add post-deploy gating around consul leader elections.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-3278 severity reduced to S2 at 23:44:05 UTC — monitoring phase.

nick: last check: SRV success 99.7% across region, error volume back to baseline. closing in 10.

morgan: closing incident in 10. good job everyone. please file postmortem with timeline + config diffs. :thumbsup:
